instruction: A studio photograph of two cheerleaders in a bright white studio. On the left, the short-haired cheerleader (R4) stands with her body turned away, looking back over her shoulder at the camera with a smile. On the right, the wavy-haired cheerleader (R10) stands with her back completely to the camera, raising one orange pom-pom high in the air. They wear matching white t-shirts and white skirts with red and yellow waistbands, holding metallic orange pom-poms. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with soft shadows on the floor.
elements: R10 raises one orange pom-pom high in the air while R4 does not take that raised-pom role
R4 looks back over her shoulder toward the camera while R10 has her back completely to the camera
R4 stands with her body turned away and smiles back at the camera
R10 stands with her back completely to the camera
the cheerleaders hold metallic orange pom-poms
the scene is a bright white studio photograph
